title: Using AutoDiag on a robot from another machine
keywords: autodiag remote access robot ssh tunnel token network listen host 0.0.0.0 allowed hosts security headless laptop from another machine open remotely
text: Keep the server on the robot at 127.0.0.1 and open it from your laptop through an SSH tunnel: ssh -L 8080:127.0.0.1:8080 robot, then browse to http://127.0.0.1:8080. To listen on the network instead, a dashboard token is mandatory: AUTODIAG_UI_TOKEN=<secret> AUTODIAG_ALLOWED_HOSTS=<robot-ip> dds-autodiag serve --host 0.0.0.0. To let another AutoDiag compare against this process under Hosts, also set AUTODIAG_AGENT_TOKEN and enter that token with the collector URL. AutoDiag has no TLS of its own, so use a TLS reverse proxy beyond a trusted network.
